blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said the impeachment court is aiming to reach a verdict on Vice President Sara Duterte’s case by November. “Maybe mid-November to end-November. Hopefully, hopefully,” he said in an interrview with radio dzBB on Sunday. Pressed further if he meant that the trial would end and the impeachment court may issue a verdict by that time, Gatchalian answered: “I think so.” The Senate leader earlier said that they expect to finish the impeachment proceedings before Christmas.
